function.name: unwrap_view_once
function.description: Open a WhatsApp view-once image and resend it to the current chat as a normal photo. Use it when the user replies to a view-once image (or sends one) and asks to unwrap, open, reveal, save, or resend it as a normal image. It only works on WhatsApp; on other platforms tell the user it is unavailable. The image is sent immediately, so keep your text reply short.

source.description: quoted: use the view-once image in the message the user replied to (default). current: use a view-once image attached to the current message.

caption.description: Optional caption for the resent image. Defaults to the original caption.
